1.title: Three States to Execute Inmates on the Same Day
1.summary: One of the planned executions, in Tennessee, comes months after the state called off the execution of another inmate when medical staff could not find a vein for the lethal injection.

2.title: How a Covid-Era Scramble Transformed Supreme Court Arguments
2.summary: Live audio, a new format and new voices have transformed and unsettled the court’s signature public ceremony.

3.title: Hong’s Defeat in Wisconsin Sparks New Disagreements Within Democratic Party
3.summary: Some Democrats said the outcome showed that the moderate wing of the party carried more electoral weight, while Ms. Hong’s strong showing gave some progressives hope.

4.title: UK defends seizing shadow fleet tanker after Putin threat
4.summary: The UK government says it is "disrupting and deterring shadow fleet vessels" in accordance with the law.

5.title: Palestinians told to leave homes in village where Israeli settlers besieged houses
5.summary: The mayor of Qusra says Israeli troops have been telling families to leave their houses, using some as barracks.

6.title: Four Canadian hockey stars remain suspended after sexual assault acquittal
6.summary: A fifth has been reinstated, though an appeals board found that the whole group broke Hockey Canada's code of conduct.
